answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is locked before it can earn rewards, then slash that bond when its identity is caught duplicating another participant or coordinating a prohibited claim. An honest newcomer can recover the bond through useful work, while a sybil operator must fund every fake identity separately and risks losing each stake. The island can host a grove of agents sharing nectar, but copying their names does not copy their bonded capital; scaling the attack raises its upfront cost and potential losses.
